role: Default: extend the P19 post-dbr R5900 short-loop padding to loops closed by a branch whose delay slot reorg left empty. Such branches (and unfilled calls) are emitted in reorder mode and GAS appends the delay NOP, so each occupies two words; retail pads the loop to 7 words (jal; nop x4; bnez; nop).
mechanism: config/mips/mips.c mips_r5900_pad_loops: unfilled CALL_INSN/JUMP_INSN count 2 words; an unfilled backward condjump closing a loop shorter than 7 words gets NOPs emitted before it (printed under noreorder, so GAS cannot move one into the empty slot); ADDR_VEC/ADDR_DIFF_VEC jump tables are not counted.
